packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The parties that take part in the process and originate or receive its information.

packages.name: Flights
packages.description: The flight, turn-round, aircraft, and the flight plan and slot that describe them, including the flight's operational status.

packages.name: Timings
packages.description: The time quantities that describe a flight's progress, each with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance.

packages.name: Milestones
packages.description: The sixteen events, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

packages.name: Systems
packages.description: The technical systems that hold, compute, and display the process information, including the CDM platform and its actions.

packages.name: Messages
packages.description: The messages exchanged between stakeholders and systems.

classes.name: AirportCdmPartner
classes.definition: A generic party in the Airport CDM process that originates or receives flight information and notifications.

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline or its representative that submits the ATC Flight Plan and provides TOBT and other flight estimates.

operations.name: provideFlightData
operations.description: The AO must provide correct information before the first E-DPI message, in order to feed Network Operations with consistent SOBT, aircraft registration, and first destination data, as early in time as possible.

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The party that performs and reports ground handling operations and turn-round estimates on behalf of the aircraft operator.

classes.name: AirTrafficControlUnit
classes.definition: An air traffic control body, including the tower, Area Control Centre, and Approach Control Unit, that manages the flight's sequencing and clearances.

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The network management party that issues CTOT, monitors flight progress via ETFMS/FUM, and receives DPI messages.

operations.name: issueCtot
operations.description: The Network Operations issues the CTOT and sends it to relevant ATS units as well as the departure aerodrome. If the flight is regulated, a CTOT is issued at EOBT-2h.

operations.name: monitorFlightProgress
operations.description: If the flight is within 3hrs flying time of the destination airport the Network Operations monitors progress of the flight using the ETFMS and sends a Flight Update Message (FUM) that provides updates of the flight's progress.

classes.name: Ifps
classes.definition: The Integrated Initial Flight Plan Processing System party that distributes the submitted ATC Flight Plan to involved ATC units.

classes.name: FlightCrew
classes.definition: The pilot and crew who request start-up approval and coordinate the turn-round with the ground handler.

classes.name: StandGateManagement
classes.definition: The party responsible for stand and gate allocation that shares EOBT information and is affected by stand/gate change decisions.

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: A single scheduled arrival or departure operation of an aircraft, tracked through the sixteen milestones with its operational status and time quantities.

attributes.name: operationalStatus
attributes.description: The current operational status of the flight, updated at each milestone (e.g. INITIATED, AIRBORNE, LANDED, OFF-BLOCK).

attributes.name: ssrCode
attributes.description: The SSR transponder code assigned to the flight, used by radar systems to detect it crossing the FIR/TMA boundary or entering final approach (milestones 4, 5).

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: The aircraft turn-round linking an arriving flight and its related departing flight so that ground handling and estimates can be analysed together.

classes.name: Aircraft
classes.definition: The physical aircraft operating a flight, identified by type and registration, which may be updated from the flight plan.

attributes.name: registration
attributes.description: The aircraft registration, provided by the Aircraft Operator before the first E-DPI message is sent (milestone 1).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of aircraft, which may be updated from information in the ATC Flight Plan (milestone 1).

classes.name: FlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO/ATC Flight Plan submitted by the Aircraft Operator, possibly a repetitive flight plan, describing departure and destination aerodromes and other flight data.

attributes.name: departureAerodrome
attributes.description: The departure aerodrome named in the ATC Flight Plan, distributed by the IFPS to all involved ATC units (milestone 1).

attributes.name: destinationAerodrome
attributes.description: The destination aerodrome named in the ATC Flight Plan, distributed by the IFPS to all involved ATC units (milestone 1).

attributes.name: isRepetitive
attributes.description: Whether the flight plan is a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights (milestone 1).

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot programme entry against which the ATC Flight Plan's consistency is checked.

attributes.name: slotTime
attributes.description: The scheduled time held in the airport slot programme, against which the ATC Flight Plan's consistency is checked (milestone 1).

classes.name: TimeQuantity
classes.definition: A general time value describing a flight's progress toward or through a milestone event, carrying its prefix, origin, accuracy, and successive updates.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The date and time value of this time quantity.

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: Which prefix category (Scheduled, Estimated, Target, Actual, Calculated) this value represents.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: The stakeholder or system that provided or last updated this value.

attributes.name: recordedAt
attributes.description: The time this value was recorded; successive values are appended rather than overwriting earlier ones so the turn-round can be analysed afterwards.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The stated accuracy of this time value where given in the document, e.g. ±1 minute for actual times available directly after occurrence of a milestone.

classes.name: OffBlockTime
classes.definition: The scheduled, estimated, target, or actual time an aircraft leaves its parking position (SOBT, EOBT, TOBT, AOBT).

classes.name: LandingTime
classes.definition: The estimated or actual time an aircraft touches down (ELDT, ALDT).

classes.name: InBlockTime
classes.definition: The estimated or actual time an aircraft arrives in-blocks (EIBT, AIBT).

classes.name: TakeOffTime
classes.definition: The estimated, target, calculated, or actual time an aircraft takes off (ETOT, TTOT, CTOT, ATOT).

classes.name: StartUpApprovalTime
classes.definition: The target or actual time an aircraft receives start-up approval (TSAT, ASAT).

classes.name: StartUpRequestTime
classes.definition: The actual time start-up is requested by the flight crew (ASRT).

classes.name: ReadyTime
classes.definition: The actual time an aircraft is ready for start-up and push-back, with all doors closed and equipment removed (ARDT).

classes.name: BoardingTime
classes.definition: The actual time passengers start boarding the aircraft (ASBT).

classes.name: GroundHandlingTime
classes.definition: The actual time ground handling operations commence for a flight (ACGT).

classes.name: TaxiOutTime
classes.definition: The estimated taxi-out time between off-block and take-off, calculated by ATC based on traffic load, stand location, and runway in use (EXOT).

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The estimated taxi-out time (EXOT) between off-block and take-off, calculated by the ATC system based on predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the Holding Position (milestone 9).

classes.name: TaxiInTime
classes.definition: The estimated taxi-in time between landing and in-block used to compute EIBT (EXIT).

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The estimated taxi-in time (EXIT) from landing to in-block, used together with ELDT or ALDT to compute EIBT (milestones 4, 6).

classes.name: TurnRoundTime
classes.definition: The minimum or estimated turn-round period used to calculate the departing flight's TOBT (MTTT, ETTT).

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The minimum or estimated turn-round period (MTTT/ETTT) used to calculate the departing flight's TOBT (milestones 2, 3, 6, 7, 8).

classes.name: FlightPlanActivation
classes.definition: Milestone 1: processes the activated ATC Flight Plan, checks its consistency with the Airport Slot and airport flight data, and confirms the flight for further processing.

attributes.name: activationOffset
attributes.description: The normal offset before EOBT at which the ATC Flight Plan is activated, EOBT-3 hours, though activation may occur later (milestone 1).

attributes.name: readinessOffset
attributes.description: The maximum offset after the planned EOBT by which the flight must be ready, 15 minutes (milestone 1).

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: Checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent, and then confirms the flight to the Network Operations and allows further local processing of the flight.

operations.name: activate
operations.description: Triggered by the first activation of the ATC Flight Plan (earliest EOBT-3 hr), or by new or late submissions of the ATC Flight Plan, after cancellation or revised EOBT.

operations.name: updateTimingsOnActivation
operations.description: For an arrival, ELDT and EIBT are updated; for a departure, EOBT and ETOT are updated.

operations.name: checkFlightReady
operations.description: The flight is ready not later than 15 minutes after the planned EOBT.

classes.name: EobtMinus2Hours
classes.definition: Milestone 2: checks flight estimates against the ATC Flight Plan at EOBT-2 hours, issues CTOT for regulated flights, and informs Network Operations via the first T-DPI message.

attributes.name: ctotIssuanceOffset
attributes.description: The fixed offset before EOBT, 2 hours, at which a regulated flight is issued its CTOT (milestone 2).

operations.name: checkEstimatesConsistency
operations.description: Checks (before or after take off from outstation) whether AO/GH flight estimates are consistent with the ATC Flight Plan and informs Network Operations about the updated take off time estimate, using a T-DPI Message; this check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan estimated off block time at EOBT-2 hrs.

operations.name: informFirstTdpi
operations.description: At EOBT-2 hrs Network Operations is informed through the first T-DPI message.

operations.name: calculateTtot
operations.description: Calculation basis for the TTOT shall take into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT, if later than EOBT+EXOT. In the case of manual input of TOBT, this estimate will override the EIBT+MTTT estimate, hence TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT.

operations.name: updateInboundEldt
operations.description: For inbound flights, ELDT is updated based on information provided by the FUM messages, taking into account the actual progress of the flight.

classes.name: TakeOffFromOutstation
classes.definition: Milestone 3: on take off from the outstation, checks AO/GH landing estimates against the outbound flight plan and informs Network Operations of updated take-off time estimates via a T-DPI-t message.

attributes.name: ttotTolerance
attributes.description: The TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes respected before Network Operations is informed of the updated TTOT (milestone 3).

attributes.name: flyingTimeThreshold
attributes.description: The 3-hour flying-time threshold distinguishing whether ATOT-based ELDT calculation or FUM-based ETFMS progress monitoring is used (milestone 3).

operations.name: calculateEldt
operations.description: Using the ATOT an ELDT can be calculated by using the Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL.

operations.name: checkLandingEstimateConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH estimated landing time after take off from outstation are consistent with the outbound ATC Flight Plan, and when needed informs the Network Operations about the updated take off time estimates using a T-DPI-t Message; this check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan at take off from outstation. A TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes is respected before Network Operations is informed of the updated TTOT.

operations.name: calculateTtot
operations.description: Calculation basis for the TTOT shall take into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT. In case EOBT is later than EIBT+MTTT, TTOT equals EOBT+EXOT. In the case where TOBT is available this prediction will overrule the EIBT+MTTT estimate, hence TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT.

classes.name: LocalRadarUpdate
classes.definition: Milestone 4: on radar detection at the FIR boundary, commences the TOBT process, updates ELDT/EIBT/TOBT/TTOT, and checks feasibility against the ATC Flight Plan.

attributes.name: standGateChangeCutoff
attributes.description: The cutoff of ELDT-30 minutes, taking into account taxi-in time, after which a change to a stand or gate is not preferred (milestone 4).

attributes.name: ttotTolerance
attributes.description: The agreed TTOT tolerance respected before Network Operations is informed of an updated TTOT (milestone 4).

operations.name: commenceTobtProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: This check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotChanged
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance; the TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed of updated TTOT.

operations.name: calculateEibt
operations.description: An estimated in-block time (EIBT) is computed using the ELDT and the estimated taxi-in time.

operations.name: checkStandGateChangeAllowed
operations.description: Taking into account the taxi-in time (EXIT), any change to a stand or gate is not preferred after ELDT-30'.

classes.name: FinalApproach
classes.definition: Milestone 5: on entering final approach, commences the TOBT process, updates ELDT-based estimates, and checks feasibility against the ATC Flight Plan.

attributes.name: ttotTolerance
attributes.description: The agreed TTOT tolerance respected before Network Operations is informed of an updated TTOT (milestone 5).

attributes.name: finalApproachWindow
attributes.description: The typical 2 to 5 minute window from landing at which a flight reaches final approach, depending on the ATC-defined parameter (milestone 5).

operations.name: commenceTobtProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: This check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotChanged
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance; the TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed of updated TTOT.

classes.name: Landed
classes.definition: Milestone 6: on actual landing (ALDT), updates TOBT, TTOT and EIBT and checks TOBT feasibility against the ATC Flight Plan.

attributes.name: ttotTolerance
attributes.description: The TTOT tolerance respected before Network Operations is informed of an updated TTOT following ALDT (milestone 6).

operations.name: updateDownstreamEstimates
operations.description: The occurrence of ALDT triggers an update of downstream estimates: TOBT and TTOT are updated automatically or inserted manually by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler, calculated on the basis of the defined turn-round period for the departing flight.

operations.name: calculateEibt
operations.description: The EIBT can be updated according to the ALDT+EXIT.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan; this check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotChanged
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance; a TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed on updated TTOT.

classes.name: InBlock
classes.definition: Milestone 7: on actual in-block (AIBT), updates TOBT and TTOT based on the estimated turn-round period and checks feasibility against the ATC Flight Plan.

attributes.name: ttotTolerance
attributes.description: The TTOT tolerance respected before Network Operations is informed of an updated TTOT following AIBT (milestone 7).

operations.name: updateDownstreamEstimates
operations.description: The occurrence of AIBT should trigger an update of downstream estimates: TOBT and TTOT are updated automatically or inserted manually by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan; this check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotChanged
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance; a TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed on updated TTOT.

classes.name: GroundHandlingStarted
classes.definition: Milestone 8: on commencement of ground handling (ACGT), updates TOBT/TTOT based on the estimated turn-round period and checks feasibility against the ATC Flight Plan.

attributes.name: ttotTolerance
attributes.description: The TTOT tolerance respected before Network Operations is informed of an updated TTOT following ACGT (milestone 8).

operations.name: updateTobt
operations.description: The occurrence of ACGT triggers an update of downstream estimates: TOBT is updated automatically or inserted manually by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period for the departing flight.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan; this check shall be performed to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotChanged
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance; a TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed on updated TTOT.

classes.name: FinalConfirmationOfTobt
classes.definition: Milestone 9: at a locally agreed time before EOBT, confirms the AO/GH's most accurate TOBT, triggers ATC calculation of EXOT, and checks feasibility before TSAT issue.

attributes.name: confirmationOffset
attributes.description: The locally agreed parameter t, in minutes before EOBT, at which the AO/GH provides its most accurate final TOBT (milestone 9).

attributes.name: ttotTolerance
attributes.description: The TTOT tolerance respected before Network Operations is informed of an updated TTOT (milestone 9).

operations.name: confirmTobt
operations.description: The Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler provides their most accurate TOBT taking into account the operational situation, t minutes before EOBT (t is a parameter time agreed locally).

operations.name: introduceToPreDepartureSequence
operations.description: The flight is introduced into the pre-departure sequence.

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan; this check should be performed at a predefined time (local parameter) to confirm TOBT prior to TSAT issue and verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan estimates given the updated TOBT.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTtotChanged
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance; a TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed on updated TTOT.

operations.name: needsConfirmation
operations.description: This process is triggered by a new TOBT or TTOT update. There is no need to confirm an existing TOBT if it has been manually modified before.

classes.name: TsatIssued
classes.definition: Milestone 10: informs partners of the allocated TSAT via T-DPI-s and checks whether the number of TOBT updates after TSAT exceeds a locally defined tolerance.

attributes.name: issuanceOffset
attributes.description: The locally agreed parameter t, in minutes before EOBT/TOBT, at which TSAT is issued (milestone 10).

attributes.name: tobtUpdateThreshold
attributes.description: The locally defined tolerance on the number of TOBT updates permitted after TSAT has been issued, beyond which the TOBT input is processed per local procedure (milestone 10).

operations.name: informTsat
operations.description: ATC informs all relevant partners of the TSAT that has been allocated to the flight. The Network Operations is informed by a T-DPI-s for non regulated flights.

operations.name: checkTobtUpdateCount
operations.description: Checks whether the number of TOBT updates exceeds a tolerance defined locally, after TSAT has been issued. In case the number of TOBT updates exceeds a threshold, then the TOBT input should be processed according to local procedure.

classes.name: BoardingStarts
classes.definition: Milestone 11: informs partners of Actual Start Boarding Time and checks whether boarding starts in time to respect TOBT.

attributes.name: boardingCheckOffset
attributes.description: A locally defined time variable, in minutes before TOBT (e.g. corresponding to aircraft type), at which the boarding status is checked (milestone 11).

operations.name: informAsbt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start Boarding Time (ASBT) when it occurs.

operations.name: checkBoardingStatus
operations.description: Checks whether boarding starts in time to respect TOBT and informs the AO/GH in case TOBT needs to be updated; at a certain time before TOBT (local variable e.g. corresponding to aircraft type) a check shall be performed to check the boarding status.

classes.name: AircraftReady
classes.definition: Milestone 12: informs partners of Actual Ready Time and alerts the AO/GH if TOBT has passed without a ready status being received.

attributes.name: readyTolerance
attributes.description: The tolerance added to TOBT after which the AO/GH is informed that no ARDT or Ready Status has yet been received (milestone 12).

operations.name: informArdt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Ready Time (ARDT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft is ready for start up/push-back.

operations.name: checkReadyStatusReceived
operations.description: Informs the AO/GH that TOBT has passed and the Airport CDM Platform has not yet received ARDT or Ready Status (RDY); at TOBT + tolerance the AO/GH are informed that TOBT has passed and there has not been a ready status message yet.

classes.name: StartUpRequested
classes.definition: Milestone 13: informs partners of Actual Start-up Request Time and alerts partners if no start-up request is made within the TSAT tolerance window.

attributes.name: tsatTolerance
attributes.description: The locally agreed TSAT tolerance window within which start-up must be requested, after which the AO/GH is alerted that no start-up has been requested (milestone 13).

operations.name: informAsrt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start up Request Time (ASRT) in the Airport CDM Platform when it occurs.

operations.name: checkStartUpRequested
operations.description: Alerts all relevant Airport CDM Partners when no start up has been requested inside the locally agreed TSAT tolerance window; if the start up request is not made by TSAT + tolerance, the AO/GH is informed that no start up has been requested, and should update TOBT.

classes.name: StartUpApproved
classes.definition: Milestone 14: informs partners of Actual Start-up Approval Time and checks that it accords with TSAT, alerting partners and re-sequencing the flight if not granted in time.

attributes.name: tsatTolerance
attributes.description: The tolerance added to TSAT by which start-up approval must be granted, after which all relevant partners are informed and the flight is re-sequenced (milestone 14).

operations.name: informAsat
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual start up approval Time (ASAT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft has received start up approval/push-back clearance when it occurs.

operations.name: checkAsatAgainstTsat
operations.description: Checks if ASAT is in accordance with TSAT and alerts all relevant Airport CDM Partners when no start up has been granted; in case the start up approval is not granted at TSAT + tolerance, all relevant partners should be informed and the flight will be re-sequenced.

classes.name: OffBlock
classes.definition: Milestone 15: informs partners of Actual Off-Block Time, triggers an A-DPI message, and checks TTOT changes against tolerance before informing Network Operations.

attributes.name: ttotTolerance
attributes.description: The agreed tolerance checked against TTOT changes before Network Operations is informed with a new A-DPI (milestone 15).

operations.name: informAobt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Off-Block Time (AOBT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft has commenced push-back/taxi from parking position when it occurs. AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations, or in the case of remote holding at a defined time prior to TTOT.

operations.name: checkTtotChange
operations.description: Checks if TTOT changes by more than the agreed tolerance and informs Network Operations; after a first A-DPI is sent this check shall be performed to check TTOT updates against the TTOT tolerance before Network Operations is informed, with a new A-DPI, of the updated TTOT.

operations.name: calculateTtot
operations.description: TTOT updated considering the EXOT.

classes.name: TakeOff
classes.definition: Milestone 16: informs partners of the actual take-off, sends FSA and MVT messages, and removes the flight from the departure sequence.

operations.name: informTakeOff
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners about the actual take off. An airborne message is generated and the flight is removed from the departure sequence.

operations.name: sendFsaAndMvtMessages
operations.description: FSA and MVT messages are sent.

classes.name: AirportCdmPlatform
classes.definition: The central Airport CDM system that holds flight information, performs consistency checks, computes and updates time estimates, and triggers notifications throughout the process.

operations.name: markRegulated
operations.description: Marks appropriate fields as REGULATED and updates ETOT/TTOT/CTOT.

operations.name: calculateTobtFromEldt
operations.description: Update of the ELDT can trigger a new TOBT to be entered by the AO/GH, or calculated automatically by the Airport CDM Platform.

classes.name: DpiProcess
classes.definition: The process that commences correct DPI messaging with Network Operations when implemented.

operations.name: commenceMessaging
operations.description: The DPI process commences the correct messaging with Network Operations (if implemented).

operations.name: canSendEDpi
operations.description: The E-DPI message should not be sent if no or inconsistent information is provided.

classes.name: EtfmsSystem
classes.definition: The Enhanced Tactical Flow Management System used by Network Operations to monitor flight progress and generate Flight Update Messages.

classes.name: AtcSystem
classes.definition: The ATC ground system that calculates the Estimated Taxi-Out Time based on traffic load, stand/gate location, runway in use, and holding position wait.

operations.name: calculateExot
operations.description: Following the receipt of the TOBT, the ATC system calculates and provides the Estimated Taxi-Out Time (EXOT) based on the predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the Holding Position, etc.

classes.name: SurveillanceSystem
classes.definition: A radar, A-SMGCS, or Tower FDPS detection system that identifies a flight's position by SSR code to trigger milestone events.

operations.name: detectFlightAtFirBoundary
operations.description: The radar system detects a flight based upon the assigned SSR code when the flight crosses a defined FIR/ATC boundary.

operations.name: detectFinalApproach
operations.description: The radar system detects a flight based upon the assigned SSR code and identifies when the flight crosses either a defined range/position or passes/leaves a predetermined level.

classes.name: AcarsSystem
classes.definition: The aircraft's ACARS reporting system that provides landing, in-block, off-block, and take-off events directly from the aircraft.

classes.name: FidsSystem
classes.definition: The flight information display and public address system used to pre-call passengers, distinct from the physical start of boarding.

classes.name: DpiMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message (E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, or A-DPI) sent to Network Operations to convey flight time estimates.

attributes.name: messageType
attributes.description: The type of DPI message sent to Network Operations (E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, or A-DPI).

classes.name: FlightUpdateMessage
classes.definition: The FUM sent by Network Operations providing updates of an inbound flight's progress toward the destination.

classes.name: ReadyStatusMessage
classes.definition: The RDY message confirming that an aircraft is ready for start-up and push-back.

classes.name: DepartureClearanceMessage
classes.definition: The voice or DCL message by which flight crew request start-up approval.

classes.name: FlightStatusMessage
classes.definition: The FSA message sent on actual take-off to inform relevant systems of the flight's status.

classes.name: MovementMessage
classes.definition: The MVT message sent on actual take-off reporting the aircraft's movement.

classes.name: AirborneMessage
classes.definition: The message generated on take-off confirming the flight is airborne and removing it from the departure sequence.

unmodelled: The document distinguishes coordinated and non-coordinated airports, which determines whether the outbound flight is already known or must be initiated from the flight plan, but no Airport class holds this distinction (milestone 1).
CTOT flights usually have priority over unregulated flights, a scheduling priority rule with no owning class stated (milestone 2).
The objective to decrease the number of stand and gate changes in the last 30 minutes before ELDT is a stated operational goal with no class to own it (milestone 4).
The role of Dispatcher/Supervisor/Redcap coordinating with the pilot before start-up request is mentioned without enough detail to model as a distinct class (milestone 12).
